Only output concatenated objects for the provided modalities. Outputs all modalities by default.

List of `string`

[Separator]{.arg-key} `";"`
:::

:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--input_id`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Names of the different samples that have to be concatenated.  Must be specified when using '--mode move'.
In this case, the ids will be used for the columns names of the dataframes registring the conflicts.
If specified, must be of same length as `--input`.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
List of `string`

[Separator]{.arg-key} `";"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--output`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Output location for the concatenated MuData object file.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`file`

[Example]{.arg-key} `"output.h5mu"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--other_axis_mode`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
How to handle the merging of other axis (var, obs, ...).

  - None: keep no data
  - same: only keep elements of the matrices which are the same in each of the samples
  - unique: only keep elements for which there is only 1 possible value (1 value that can occur in multiple samples)
  - first: keep the annotation from the first sample
  - only: keep elements that show up in only one of the objects (1 unique element in only 1 sample)
  - move: identical to 'same', but moving the conflicting values to .varm or .obsm
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`

[Default]{.arg-key} `"move"`

[Choices]{.arg-key} `"same"`, `"unique"`, `"first"`, `"only"`, `"concat"`, `"move"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--uns_merge_mode`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
How to handle the merging of .uns across modalities

  - None: keep no data
  - same: only keep elements of the matrices which are the same in each of the samples
  - unique: only keep elements for which there is only 1 possible value (1 value that can occur in multiple samples)
  - first: keep the annotation from the first sample
  - only: keep elements that show up in only one of the objects (1 unique element in only 1 sample)
  - make_unique: identical to 'unique', but keys which are not unique are made unique by prefixing them with the sample id.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`

[Default]{.arg-key} `"make_unique"`

[Choices]{.arg-key} `"same"`, `"unique"`, `"first"`, `"only"`, `"make_unique"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--obsp_keys`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
List of `.obsp` keys for which block-diagonal concatenation should be performed.
If not provided, no `.obsp` keys will be concatenated.
Provided keys must be present in all samples for block concatenation to be performed.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
List of `string`

[Separator]{.arg-key} `";"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--output_compression`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Compression format to use for the output AnnData and/or Mudata H5 files.
By default no compression is applied.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`

[Example]{.arg-key} `"gzip"`

[Choices]{.arg-key} `"gzip"`, `"lzf"`
:::
::::
:::::

## Example commands

You can run the pipeline using `nextflow run`.

### View help

You can use `--help` as a parameter to get an overview of the possible parameters.

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline \
  -r v4.2.0 -latest \
  -main-script target/nextflow/dataflow/concatenate_h5mu/main.nf \
  --help
```

### Run command

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Create a params.yaml"}
The command below reads this component's arguments from a `params.yaml` file. To create one:

- generate it with the form on [Viash Hub](https://www.viash-hub.com/packages/openpipeline/v4.2.0/components/dataflow/concatenate_h5mu);
- see examples of using params files in the [guides](/guides/index.qmd);
- run several samples in one go with a [`param_list`](/guides/process-many-samples.qmd).
:::

Run locally with:

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline \
  -r v4.2.0 -latest \
  -profile docker \
  -main-script target/nextflow/dataflow/concatenate_h5mu/main.nf \
  -params-file params.yaml
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Other backends and platforms"}
Replace `-profile docker` with `-profile podman` or `-profile singularity` depending on the desired backend. To run on Seqera Platform or through Viash Hub, see the [guides](/guides/index.qmd).
:::
